title: StageExitInput
description: Input of `gentry stage exit --input`: the fields as one object, in a file or on the standard input. An unknown field is an error. The source is not part of the input: Gentry determines it by who calls the command.

kind.description: Kind of the exit: artifact — an artifact of the task, result — the result of an event, negative — a negative result with where it was looked for.

artifact.description: Name of the artifact of the task; only for an exit of kind artifact.

to.description: The node to go to, or finish; required at a fork.

reason.description: Why the transition is taken; required at a fork and for a single transition with a condition.
